beam.name: BEAM Dashboard - Report Data
beam.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
beam.location: BEAM (Bacteria, Enterics, Amoeba, and Mycotics) Dashboard
beam.description: The BEAM Dashboard is an interactive tool built on the System for Enteric Disease Response, Investigation, and Coordination (SEDRIC) that provides timely data on enteric pathogen trends and serotype details to support prevention of illnesses from food, water, and animal contact. This source uses the state-level 'Report Data' export (dataset jbhn-e8xn) rather than the HHS-region export, so isolate counts can be represented with standard state FIPS codes. Raw records are aggregated across source type (human, food, animal, environment), source site, and serotype/species to produce a monthly isolate count per state and pathogen. National values are computed by PopHIVE/Ingest as the sum across all reporting states. Counts reflect isolates sequenced and reported by participating state and local public health laboratories, which varies by jurisdiction and pathogen, so trends should not be interpreted as complete disease incidence.
beam.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
